result.summary:
The whole duel UI is now in the murim ink-wash idiom and every player-facing name follows MURIM.md; all screens were captured and read at 1280x720, 844x390 touch and 390x844 touch. In the real game I captured title, select, versus, K.O. and two ultimates on an earlier build; the final code was only bundle-checked, and the 60 fps profile was not run (machine saturated, one game run was killed at its 30-minute limit).

**Names**
- Title, heroes (name / 별호 / sect / weapon / inner art, each Korean + Hanja + English), CPU ranks 삼류 / 이류 / 일류 / 절정, arena 천무대 天武臺 and a full 30-move 초식 table are in place.
- `src/ui/roster.js` is now the single source; `registry.js` builds `ROSTER` from it, so the menus, HUD, banner and game cannot drift apart.
- `moves.js` (name / title fields and comments only), `MOVES.md` (re-flavoured, mechanics and numbers kept) and `BALANCE.md` (names only) are updated. Frame-data output is identical before and after for all three heroes, and non-comment code is byte-identical apart from the name fields.

**Look**
- Display Korean is written stroke by stroke by a new procedural brush engine (`brush.js` on `ink.js`), not typed. It composes any Hangul syllable, so the title, announcer cards, hero names and 오의 banners look the same on every device with no font.
- Seals, dry-brush rules, the ink eclipse, ink mountains, splashes, band shapes and paper / wash textures are all generated in code from fixed seeds.
- Title: black sun behind brush-written 「흑일무림」 with the seal 黑日武林, mountains at the foot.
- Select: weapon line art redrawn (great saber, twin crescents, tasselled spear), our own sect emblems, names down paper cartouches with hero seals.
- HUD: 기혈 as brushed ink bands with element inner glow, eclipse dial with numerals over a burning incense stick, round pips as 勝 seals, 내공 / 오의 gauges.
- Announcer: 제 n 합, 겨뤄라!, 결 決, 무결 無缺, 향이 다 탔다, 승 勝 / 패 敗, each brushed in with its Hanja stamped as a seal; transform / opacity only.
- The 오의 cut-in is a vertical banner at the user's side of the screen, so the hero shot stays clear.
- Result, pause, quality menu, move list and touch-pad glyphs are restyled; the versus screen too.

**Checks**
- No clipped or overlapping text at the three sizes; the old portrait bugs are gone. The title now measures itself and shrinks as one block, so the RPG team's 강호행 row cannot crop it.
- HUD and cards stay readable over a pure white stage after adding ink backing behind the combo, docks and subtitles.
- Interaction tests pass on the final captured build: 16/16 keyboard, 25/25 touch.
- The RPG team's title entry and hooks in `screens.js` / `game/index.js` are preserved.
- After the last capture pass I removed dead markup (`hp-cap`, unused Hanja on segmented options) and added `hud.dismiss()`; that state got a smoke run (every screen, `dismiss`, one `hudFight` frame) and a game bundle check, not a full re-capture.

**Behaviour changes to know**
- `hud.announce(text, { style: 'ult', side })` now shows that fighter's own 오의 from the roster and ignores `text`; pass `hanja` for a custom banner.
- New `hud.dismiss(style, dur)`, presets `win` / `lose`, and an `o.seal` option.
- The winner card is now the winner's brush name with a 勝 seal; 승 / 패 from the player's side is on the result screen.
issues: NOT DONE - 60 fps profile: src/game/tests/profile.mjs was not run. Load average was 40-60 from parallel teams, a single game capture took over 30 minutes and one was killed at the 30-minute background limit. Only the UI microbenchmark was measured (see perf).

NOT DONE - result screen in the real game: the killed run never reached it. It is covered in the UI lab at all three sizes only. The in-game frames I do have (title, select, versus, K.O., both ultimates) come from an earlier build; later UI changes were verified in the lab, not re-captured in the game.
NOT DONE - stills only: every capture is a single frame per state, so the brush-in animations themselves were not reviewed frame by frame.

src/main.js (integration, not in my file list): the loading veil still reads '일식결투 · ECLIPSE DUEL' with a Cinzel font stack. It should read '흑일무림 黑日武林 · ECLIPSE DUEL' with the myeongjo stack; it is the first thing the player sees.

src/fighters/iska/present.js:19 still hard-codes ULT_NAME = '떨어지는 서릿별 / Fall of the Frozen Star'. The banner now shows the roster's 빙성낙월 氷星落月 regardless (confirmed in the game probe), but the constant should be dropped.

src/fighters/kael/present.js fadeUltCard() reaches into the HUD DOM ('.ann.st-ult > .an-fit') to dissolve the cut-in at the leap. The selector still works; ui.hud.dismiss('ult', dur) now exists for this. Since the banner no longer covers the hero, the early dismissal may not be needed at all.
Behaviour change: hud.announce(text, { style: 'ult', side }) ignores text / sub when that side's roster entry has an ult move. Pass o.hanja (or '') for a custom banner.

RPG title entry: src/rpg's 강호행 row is preserved. I added class rules for .tt-exp-btn / .tt-exp-label in ui.css, with a few !important over their inline styles (ink border, focus state, portrait layout). They can drop the inline styles.

Sandbox fonts: no Korean serif is installed here (only WenQuanYi Zen Hei, a sans with bitmap strikes at 12-16 px), so Hanja accents and body text in my captures are sans. Brush-written Hangul and seal frames are font-independent. I widened Hanja accent letter-spacing so the bitmap strikes do not collide.

Old names remain in files I do not own: the CONTRACT.md roster table, package.json description, src/fighters/*/README.md, clips/NAMES.md, comments in present.js / fx.js, and labs art*.js / audio.js / env.js.

Game code keeps the technical marker names 'rune' and 'armour' (identifiers); only player-facing text says 진법 / 호신강기. In-game frames still show the armoured knights and the old arena, which belong to other teams.

Coinages to confirm with the owner: 향진 香盡 (time-out, on round chips and the time-up seal), 和 as the draw seal, 숨 고르기 / 調息 for pause, 산문으로 for quit-to-title, 천명 for random, and button labels 경초 / 중초 / 호신 / 경공.

result.perf:
Measured: UI microbenchmark only. `src/ui/tests/interaction.mjs` reports 600 `hud.set` + `skills` + `combo` updates at 0.109 ms each on the desktop lab run (the previous README quoted about 0.1 ms) and 0.379 ms on the touch run, which was taken at load average ~59 and also drives the pad meters. Zero DOM growth in both (1754 and 1767 nodes steady).

Not measured: the game frame profile (`src/game/tests/profile.mjs`) and any before / after frame-time comparison, because the machine was saturated by parallel capture jobs.

By construction, not measurement:
- Announcer lines no longer carry CSS drop-shadow filters (the shadow is a second ink copy inside the SVG), so there is less per-frame filter work than the baseline.
- All procedural art is generated once at creation as strings or data URLs. Brush geometry is cached per text and written at `hud.setup()` behind the versus splash, so no card computes strokes mid-fight.
- Animations remain transform / opacity on the existing tween runner.
- Draw calls and triangles are untouched (DOM only).
